items.title: Sonny Williams Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: Old man is fine. But play a clarinet too. Now he teach trombone.

ctx.x: I see. Get the band in there and rehearse them.

Yeah, after they get lined up on it, then he rehearses them. You see? Yeah. Old man is fine. But play a clarinet too. Now he teach trombone. I never heard him play trombone. He teach trombone. He plays the trumpet, clarinet, violin, bass violin.
Well I guess in those times if he could play trombone, he could play trombone. Wasn't that much different then?
